storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Proud, willful, self-centered... Many who have interacted with her would describe her personality as such. She seems to have always been treated like the center of the universe in her last living arrangement; perhaps it was this meticulous care that cultivated her spoiled nature.

"Hey! What are you looking at? Didn't I say that if I call you three times, you have to respond to this young lady?!"

—One must be very careful, even when reading the documents.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
Year 3@2 Summer, legends of sea monsters spread across the Irian Isles.

Fishermen claimed to have spotted a five-story-tall cephalopod near the shore. Its skin was deep crimson, with black concentric rings on its tentacles.

I heard this rumor while verifying suspected D-phenomenon in Mianland with Senior Johansen. The next day, the senior set sail for the Irian Isles, and I wrote this report in the Amirante Ocean.

On the third day of sailing, vast fish carcasses appeared: mackerel, flounder, dolphins, and even a pregnant sperm whale—I swear! Old sailors blamed oxygen depletion caused by overbreeding, but I felt like we were missing something...

On the eighth day of sailing, my seasickness worsened, and severe nausea made it nearly impossible to eat. Despite nearing the Irian Isles, Johansen insisted on returning@3... I didn't understand, but I trusted the senior.

—Bale Columbus "Year 3@2 Summer Internship Report"

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
After being Awakened, we finally learned what kind of life Murphy led in the Order.

She spends a lot of time on her appearance before going out, always carrying a parasol. Afternoon tea is at 4 PM, accompanied by milk tea and strawberry jam scones. Maintaining cleanliness and elegance, living like a lady—this is her destiny, and she insists on living as such no matter where she is.

(Note from the Archivist: I think her grabbing beef pudding with her hands is far from ladylike...)

Even without servants to command, she lives exactly as she wishes, which is somewhat comforting.

Due to a certain Event, she rarely interacts with Awakeners Miriam and Goliath, often ignoring them. She displays a complex expression when meeting Awakener Tulu.

Talking about the past makes her irritable. Perhaps she just needs more time to heal.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
"You bear a noble mission, the hope of His return to the world."

"Be good, obey... When He wakes again, everyone will dwell in the eternal realm."

The secret girl, whose birth could not be revealed, became the high priest's treasure for some reason. The once-neglected infant transformed into the saint linked to destiny and a mysterious civilization.

The ascetic mother raised her; worship and adoration surrounded her. Whatever she desired, someone would offer without hesitation.

Had the D-phenomenon not occurred, had the vessel of God not weakened, she would have simply succeeded the high priest, leading the followers in an orderly manner.

Yet, everything she gained came at a heavy price—a fate she never wished for, predestined to end inescapably.

To become the Mother of God, bearing the prophesied child—the glory of the saint demanded her willing sacrifice of body and life.

The day a second heart began beating in her chest, her soul turned into a surging torrent, destined to vanish with time.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
The arrogance of disregarding others is merely an empty show of force. Beneath that elegant dress lies a rebellious heart known only to herself.

Trapped in a beautiful cage crafted by sacred narratives, Murphy understands better than anyone the hypocrisy of humans and gods: the gaze of the congregation upon her is nothing but fear and pity, and the care shown by her "nurturers" is merely for a sacrificial offering. The end goal of her mission will not be glory, but her own death — she already knows the outcome. How could she be lost in the distant kingdom painted by doctrines?

The plans for deification, the revival of the old king, so many unrealistic expectations placed upon her — yet no one has ever cared whether she is willing to accept a doomed fate for an uncertain future.

The canary does not wish to remain forever trapped in a cage; thus it flaps its wings toward the thorny fence. Determined to wager her life to break free from the shackles of destiny, she must now decide the direction of her flight herself.

"My name is Murphy... don't think you can order me around! I know what I should do and what I shouldn't do."

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: Ugh, isn't this annoying? Stop pestering me about that! ...Fine, do what you want. It's just a way to kill time, after all.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: Stop! This is a robbery! I suggest you be sensible and hand over all your candy, or else... Hmph.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: What? You actually expect a "thank you" from me?

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Those despicable people at Mythag, daring to block my access to candy! See? I still got to have them in the end!

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: As a tribute, it is hardly adequate... but seeing your sincerity, I suppose I'll accept it. Just this once.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: How do they get the filling inside? I can't find any seams or pinholes! I wish these candy inventors would join Mythag's staff and invent a new dessert for me every single day!

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: Did you truly believe this would make me listen to you?

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: Soft, hard, crunchy, flaky, milky, fruity, nutty, chocolatey... Ah, how can there be so many varieties I haven't tasted yet? I've decided: Mythag must make Halloween a weekly holiday!

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: Have you reserved the venue? It must be a garden at least 150 square meters!

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: You're far more thoughtful than those dreadful waiters—even reserved some candy just for me. Keep up the good work, my exclusive servant.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: Brownie, caramel pudding, Sachertorte, chocolate mousse, cookies... All must be served on every single table!

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: You still have chocolate? Excellent, give it all to me. What? Your stuff is my stuff; isn't that only natural?

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: The tables and chairs must have lace that suits my taste, and the potted plants must be red spider lilies... Now, hurry and get this prepared!

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: What? You can roast this kind of marshmallow? But it's gonna get hot and sticky... You sure it tastes good? Let me try... Fine, I'll take a nibble. If you dare to trick me... Huh?! This soft and crispy texture is actually amazing!

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: Go and invite the guests! Is even this simple task too much for you?

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: Which candy do I like the most? Let me think... Hazelnut brittle is fragrant, caramel chocolate is delicious, those strawberry and grape-flavored gummies have quite the fun texture, and there's a malt sugar that can be pulled very long and has a beautiful color like honey... No, I refuse to choose. Every candy has its own unique charm! Anyway, I have plenty of pumpkin baskets, so I'll just take them all!

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: Check my dress for me, quickly! No wrinkles, nothing loose... What? Is there a problem?

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: My current life goal is to eat every single candy in the world. Just thinking about the countless kinds of candy waiting for me out there... that is my entire reason for getting out of bed. Cake, you say? Cake is my other life goal.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: Welcome to my final Enlightenment Ceremony! All of this was meticulously designed by me. Of course, you contributed... a tiny bit.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: Hahaha! Mine, all mine! All of Mythag's candies belong to me! What are you waiting for? Follow me, the great Candy Witch! We're going to conquer every candy shop in Londinium right now!

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: You'd better not put on airs with me. Know your place! I call the shots in this room.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Are there really Witches out there? If they live in deserted forests, who handles their cooking, cleaning, and dessert preparation? If you can't even host an afternoon tea, what is the point of that life? I can't even stand the thought of it.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Don't just barge into a lady's room, and do not comment on her demeanor. Leave now, I need to rest.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: If I were a witch, my palace would be the height of luxury, of course. I'd hire ten master chefs to make new cakes and candies for me daily... That would make me a princess, not a witch, you say? So what? I shall be the Princess Witch!

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: I dislike those slimy tentacles, and I do not like the deep sea... Don't give me that knowing look! I am not a child afraid of my parents!

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: I heard witches have a mysterious black cat. But that disgusting campus stray is too embarrassing for a fine lady like me. So, it's settled now. Put on this {Male=catboy,Female=catgirl} headband. I'll make you my little black cat.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Living in their illusory dreams, stripped of my right to be normal, without any choice... all for a ridiculous prophecy... I was willing to do anything to escape this life!

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: You found a new candy? Let me see... Tsk, this Ring Pop looks so ridiculous! A "diamond" ring the size of an egg? Wait! What do you mean by presenting me with a ring? Explain yourself immediately!

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content:
Was my only option to wait for death? Could anyone help me? Could I truly resist? I asked myself this daily. The answer was in my mind—I just never dared to see it... If you hadn't appeared, I don't know if I'd have the courage to fight back.
Th-Thank you—don't get me wrong, this isn't a confession or anything!

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: No more plush lambskin rugs, black pearl necklaces or silk pajamas from the far east... and yet, to wake up every day in a room full of candy, with baskets overflowing... this might be what happiness truly looks like... Hey, wipe that silly smile off your face! If you want to serve me forever, you still have a lot of work to do!

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: You want some of my candy? Hmph. I'm feeling generous, so I might bestow a piece upon you... if you beg nicely, that is.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: The world is full of dark, disgusting things. Instead of worrying about its end, you'd be better off using that time to eat some more candy before it happens.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: The rules at Mythag's restaurant are often annoying, but their pastry skills... hmm, they're barely passable, I suppose.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: I used to find candy too plain and not elegant enough compared to cake, but now it seems I underestimated these little things in colorful plastic wrappers. They have such a long shelf life! I could hoard as much as I want, I could fill the whole room with them!

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Why does that little mouse get to blatantly steal candy, yet I cannot? This is blatant discrimination against a lady! Such disrespect!

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: Why are you stopping me? As my faithful servant, shouldn't you be actively helping me rob... I mean, acquire all the candy?

daily.title: Chat: About Jenkin
daily.content: I admit she has a crude skill for stealing, but a fine lady like me has no need for such despicable tricks. If I desire something, I simply make them hand it over "voluntarily."

daily.title: Chat: About Lily
daily.content: That child is frighteningly obedient. She just hands over all her candy... which actually makes me feel marginally bad. Ahem! I mean, since she's so sensible, the benevolent Witch will naturally leave her some candies... as a small reward!

daily.title: Chat: About Tulu
daily.content: Don't be fooled by his looks! Tulu looks like a child, but he's practically a resident of the grave. He has no use for anything a living person enjoys, certainly not candy. So, the candy allocated to him... you should hand it all to me. I am the only one who will truly appreciate it.

daily.title: Chat: About Candy
daily.content: Hey! Go fetch me several varieties of toothpaste, quickly! No, I haven't eaten that much candy! And I do not have a cavity! It just... hurts a little when I sleep...

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Hey! Hands off my dress, you're wrinkling it! ...Fine, I'll allow it this time, generous as I am.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: The one who lent her power to me has been tormented by Dissolution... What kind of look is that? Don't even think about it! I won't tell you where She is!

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: This place is absolutely dreadful! How dare they expect me to share a table for afternoon tea! ...The homemade cookies are acceptable, though. Send a plate to my room after dinner.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag II
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
daily.content:
Everyone at this school seems so busy, but...
There's a quiet peace here I've never known.
Working together toward the same goal... Hmph, I suppose it's not entirely awful.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: What! You didn't manage to get a single one?! Not the Constantinople carpet, the Ceylon tea, or the Andalucía churros...? Ugh, that woman always gets them so easily! I thought they were common!

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Huh? How could you allow stray cats to roam the campus?! What if that savage creature scratches someone?!

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: I am the master, you are the servant. Whatever I desire must be brought to me immediately. What? You expect a reward? Fine, take it, then!

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper II
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
daily.content:
Thank you... H-Huh? Why am I saying that? Well, obviously! It's for everything you did for me at sea...
Wait, why are you laughing?! You just want to see me flustered!

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper III
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
daily.content:
The bed is too hard, the weather too cold, the tea tastes like dirty rinse water... I have a thousand reasons to despise this place. 
However, since you're here, I suppose I can tolerate it. Reluctantly.

daily.title: Chat: About Miryam
daily.content: You! How did you let that woman in here?! Set up a perimeter immediately! Keep her at least fifty steps away from me!

daily.title: Chat: About Miryam II
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
daily.content:
I once believed there was some sort of familial bond between us...
But now, after everything, I realize those fleeting warm moments were just my wishful thinking.
What you do with her is your business, just keep her away from me.

daily.title: Chat: About Tulu
daily.content: Damn it, he's just a boy! Why do you all treat him with such respect?! Show me the same reverence, understood?!

daily.title: Chat: About Caecus
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
daily.content:
He joined the cult while I was asleep, so I have no connection to him.
I heard he came willingly, wanting to abandon his human form to become a full Seafarer... Hmph, another fool blinded by power.

daily.title: Chat: About Goliath
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
daily.content: Goliath was never a loyal pet. I cannot understand why Miryam values him so much... If he wasn't chained, he would have run off and betrayed her immediately.

daily.title: Chat: About Daily Life
daily.content: Hey, do you know what the other Awakeners usually do? Don't misunderstand, I don't want friends, I just... I'm simply making an inspection!

daily.title: Chat: About the "Ghost Ship"
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
daily.content: Celeste's off-key sea shanty, the captain's signature smoked fish stew, blankets stiff and fishy from the sea breeze... Though tense and dangerous, I will never forget those months in exile at sea.

daily.title: Chat: About Seafarers
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
daily.content:
Seafarers are not born this way. To blend in, they live their first half just like humans...
You'd better watch out—your favorite cake shop owner might be one of them!

daily.title: Chat: About "Awakeners"
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
daily.content:
How peculiar... This feeling is so strange.
My heart has stopped, yet my body is still warm... Hey, come here and touch my hand. Tell me this isn't some trick.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: Hmph. Disrespectful! Very well, I'll humor you with a little game.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: The Righteous Candy Witch has arrived! All lost sweets shall return to their proper, glorious owner!

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: Phew... I'm so sleepy. Have you prepared some proper refreshments before I rest?

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: The Great Witch shall be victorious! The great candy god protects me, and I, in turn, protect all candy! AHAHAHA!

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: Don't you dare think this is over! I will make you pay for every ounce of this humiliation!

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: Curse you, you stingy thing! I'll remember your face...

battle.title: Skill: I
battle.content: Don't you dare mess with the Witch!

battle.title: Rouse
battle.content: I truly wish I didn't have to use this power.

battle.title: Rouse
battle.content: How dare you call this "robbery?" I am simply exercising a lady's noble privilege!

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: Since you have crowned me your Holy Maiden, you will submit!

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: All candy shall eventually belong to me!

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: False missions, destined futures... I will fight them until the very end!

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: No candy? Then this Witch will be forced to get serious!

traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase

traphase.title: Chat: About Karen
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: If you dare bring that dark, smelly cake of yours in front of me again, I'll blow your head wide open!

traphase.title: Chat: About Doresain
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: How rude! Stop looking at me like I'm a little cupcake!

traphase.title: Chat: About Goliath
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Ugh, you're so annoying! Leave me alone!

traphase.title: Chat: About Miryam
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: After all you've done, now you're here to show your "motherly love"? Sorry, but I don't need it anymore!

traphase.title: Chat: About Murphy: Fauxborn
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Willingly giving up freedom to become a compliant prisoner... I will absolutely not become like you!

traphase.title: Thinking
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Tsk... I haven't admitted defeat yet!

traphase.title: Urging
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: What, struggling to think of a way to win? Of course you can't win against me!

traphase.title: Fatal Blow
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Hah! I'll show you what I can do!

traphase.title: Blunder
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Huh? My cake! You just spilled it all over the place!

traphase.title: Death
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: I'll remember this... Just you wait...
